CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_get_employee_phl_balance_detail(p_employee_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_employee public.employees%rowtype;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_active_balance numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_active_ledger numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_legacy_balance numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_expired_balance numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_expiring_30_days numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_next_expiry date := null;
  v_lots jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_adjustments jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Sesi login tidak ditemukan. Silakan login ulang.';
  end if;

  select lower(coalesce(au.role, ''))
  into v_actor_role
  from public.app_users au
  where au.id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(au.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if not (
    coalesce(v_actor_role, '') like '%hr%'
    or coalesce(v_actor_role, '') like '%admin%'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Hanya akun HR/Admin aktif yang dapat membuka detail saldo PHL karyawan.';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_employee
  from public.employees
  where id = p_employee_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Data karyawan tidak ditemukan.';
  end if;

  select
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case
          when coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
            and (
              pr.expired_at is null
              or pr.expired_at >= current_date
            )
          then coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0)
          else 0
        end
      ),
      0
    ),
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case
          when coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
            and pr.expired_at is not null
            and pr.expired_at < current_date
          then coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0)
          else 0
        end
      ),
      0
    ),
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case
          when coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
            and pr.expired_at between current_date and current_date + 30
          then coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0)
          else 0
        end
      ),
      0
    ),
    min(pr.expired_at) filter (
      where coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
        and pr.expired_at is not null
        and pr.expired_at >= current_date
    )
  into
    v_active_ledger,
    v_expired_balance,
    v_expiring_30_days,
    v_next_expiry
  from public.phl_records pr
  where pr.employee_id = v_employee.id
    and lower(coalesce(pr.source, '')) = 'attendance_phl_approved'
    and lower(coalesce(pr.status, '')) = 'approved';

  select coalesce(lb.remaining_days, 0)
  into v_legacy_balance
  from public.phl_employee_legacy_balances lb
  where lb.employee_id = v_employee.id;

  v_active_balance :=
    public.phl_sync_employee_effective_balance(v_employee.id);

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', lot.id,
        'phl_date', lot.phl_date,
        'valid_from', lot.valid_from,
        'expired_at', lot.expired_at,
        'balance_days', lot.balance_days,
        'used_days', lot.used_days,
        'remaining_days', lot.remaining_days,
        'reason', lot.reason,
        'notes', lot.notes,
        'is_expired', (
          lot.expired_at is not null
          and lot.expired_at < current_date
        ),
        'days_to_expiry', case
          when lot.expired_at is null then null
          else lot.expired_at - current_date
        end
      )
      order by
        lot.expired_at asc nulls last,
        lot.phl_date desc nulls last,
        lot.created_at desc
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_lots
  from (
    select pr.*
    from public.phl_records pr
    where pr.employee_id = v_employee.id
      and lower(coalesce(pr.source, '')) = 'attendance_phl_approved'
      and lower(coalesce(pr.status, '')) = 'approved'
    order by
      pr.expired_at asc nulls last,
      pr.phl_date desc nulls last,
      pr.created_at desc
    limit 50
  ) lot;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', adj.id,
        'action', adj.action,
        'days', adj.days,
        'phl_date', adj.phl_date,
        'expired_at', adj.expired_at,
        'balance_before', adj.balance_before,
        'balance_after', adj.balance_after,
        'reason', adj.reason,
        'actor_email', adj.actor_email,
        'created_at', adj.created_at
      )
      order by adj.created_at desc
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_adjustments
  from (
    select a.*
    from public.phl_hr_adjustments a
    where a.employee_id = v_employee.id
    order by a.created_at desc
    limit 30
  ) adj;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'employee_id', v_employee.id,
    'employee_number', v_employee.employee_number,
    'full_name', v_employee.full_name,
    'active_balance', v_active_balance,
    'active_ledger_balance', v_active_ledger,
    'legacy_balance', v_legacy_balance,
    'expired_balance', v_expired_balance,
    'expiring_30_days', v_expiring_30_days,
    'next_expiry', v_next_expiry,
    'expiry_rule_days', 90,
    'lots', v_lots,
    'adjustments', v_adjustments
  );
end;
$function$

  ) adj;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,

  );
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_get_legacy_phl_claims()
 RETURNS TABLE(claim_record_id uuid, employee_id uuid, employee_number text, full_name text, department text, "position" text, phl_date date, claim_days numeric, allocated_days numeric, override_consumed_days numeric, tracking_gap_days numeric, legacy_review_status text, legacy_review_note text, legacy_reviewed_by text, legacy_reviewed_at timestamp with time zone, hr_approved_by text, hr_approved_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_role text;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Sesi login tidak ditemukan. Silakan login ulang.';
  end if;

  select lower(coalesce(au.role, ''))
  into v_actor_role
  from public.app_users au
  where au.id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(au.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if not (
    coalesce(v_actor_role, '') like '%hr%'
    or coalesce(v_actor_role, '') like '%admin%'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Hanya akun HR/Admin aktif yang dapat membuka klaim legacy PHL.';
  end if;

  return query
  with tracking as (
    select
      claim.id as claim_record_id,
      claim.employee_id,
      claim.employee_number,
      claim.full_name,
      claim.department,
      claim.position,
      claim.phl_date,
      coalesce(
        nullif(claim.used_days, 0),
        nullif(claim.balance_days, 0),
        0
      )::numeric as claim_days,
      coalesce(allocation_data.allocated_days, 0)::numeric as allocated_days,
      coalesce(approval_data.override_consumed_days, 0)::numeric as override_consumed_days,
      abs(
        coalesce(
          nullif(claim.used_days, 0),
          nullif(claim.balance_days, 0),
          0
        )::numeric
        -
        (
          coalesce(allocation_data.allocated_days, 0)::numeric
          +
          coalesce(approval_data.override_consumed_days, 0)::numeric
        )
      )::numeric as tracking_gap_days,
      claim.legacy_review_status,
      claim.legacy_review_note,
      claim.legacy_reviewed_by,
      claim.legacy_reviewed_at,
      claim.hr_approved_by,
      claim.hr_approved_at
    from public.phl_records claim
    left join lateral (
      select
        coalesce(sum(pca.allocated_days), 0)::numeric as allocated_days
      from public.phl_claim_allocations pca
      where pca.claim_record_id = claim.id
        and pca.reversed_at is null
    ) allocation_data on true
    left join lateral (
      select
        greatest(
          coalesce(pcal.employee_override_before, 0)
          -
          coalesce(pcal.employee_override_after, 0),
          0
        )::numeric as override_consumed_days
      from public.phl_claim_audit_logs pcal
      where pcal.claim_record_id = claim.id
        and pcal.action = 'hr_approved'
      order by pcal.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) approval_data on true
    where lower(coalesce(claim.source, '')) = 'employee_phl_claim'
      and (
        lower(coalesce(claim.status, '')) = 'approved'
        or lower(coalesce(claim.hr_status, '')) = 'approved'
      )
  )
  select
    t.claim_record_id,
    t.employee_id,
    t.employee_number::text,
    t.full_name::text,
    t.department::text,
    t.position::text,
    t.phl_date,
    t.claim_days,
    t.allocated_days,
    t.override_consumed_days,
    t.tracking_gap_days,
    t.legacy_review_status::text,
    t.legacy_review_note::text,
    t.legacy_reviewed_by::text,
    t.legacy_reviewed_at,
    t.hr_approved_by::text,
    t.hr_approved_at
  from tracking t
  where t.tracking_gap_days > 0.0001
  order by
    case
      when lower(coalesce(t.legacy_review_status, '')) = 'reviewed' then 2
      else 1
    end,
    t.hr_approved_at desc nulls last,
    t.phl_date desc nulls last;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_get_phl_reconciliation()
 RETURNS TABLE(employee_id uuid, employee_number text, full_name text, department text, "position" text, manual_phl_balance numeric, active_ledger_balance numeric, manual_ledger_difference numeric, expired_remaining_balance numeric, total_earned_days numeric, total_used_days numeric, pending_claim_count bigint, approved_claim_count bigint, legacy_untracked_claim_count bigint, reviewed_legacy_claim_count bigint, reconciliation_status text, last_reviewed_by text, last_reviewed_at timestamp with time zone, last_review_note text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_role text;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Sesi login tidak ditemukan. Silakan login ulang.';
  end if;

  select lower(coalesce(au.role, ''))
  into v_actor_role
  from public.app_users au
  where au.id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(au.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if not (
    coalesce(v_actor_role, '') like '%hr%'
    or coalesce(v_actor_role, '') like '%admin%'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Hanya akun HR/Admin aktif yang dapat membuka rekonsiliasi PHL.';
  end if;

  return query
  with source_agg as (
    select
      pr.employee_id,
      coalesce(sum(coalesce(pr.balance_days, 0)), 0)::numeric as total_earned_days,
      coalesce(sum(coalesce(pr.used_days, 0)), 0)::numeric as total_used_days,
      coalesce(
        sum(
          case
            when lower(coalesce(pr.status, '')) = 'approved'
              and coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
              and (
                pr.expired_at is null
                or pr.expired_at >= current_date
              )
            then coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0)
            else 0
          end
        ),
        0
      )::numeric as active_ledger_balance,
      coalesce(
        sum(
          case
            when lower(coalesce(pr.status, '')) = 'approved'
              and coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
              and pr.expired_at is not null
              and pr.expired_at < current_date
            then coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0)
            else 0
          end
        ),
        0
      )::numeric as expired_remaining_balance
    from public.phl_records pr
    where lower(coalesce(pr.source, '')) = 'attendance_phl_approved'
      and pr.employee_id is not null
    group by pr.employee_id
  ),
  claim_tracking as (
    select
      claim.id as claim_record_id,
      claim.employee_id,
      coalesce(
        nullif(claim.used_days, 0),
        nullif(claim.balance_days, 0),
        0
      )::numeric as claim_days,
      coalesce(allocation_data.allocated_days, 0)::numeric as allocated_days,
      coalesce(approval_data.override_consumed_days, 0)::numeric as override_consumed_days,
      abs(
        coalesce(
          nullif(claim.used_days, 0),
          nullif(claim.balance_days, 0),
          0
        )::numeric
        -
        (
          coalesce(allocation_data.allocated_days, 0)::numeric
          +
          coalesce(approval_data.override_consumed_days, 0)::numeric
        )
      )::numeric as tracking_gap_days,
      lower(coalesce(claim.legacy_review_status, '')) as legacy_review_status
    from public.phl_records claim
    left join lateral (
      select
        coalesce(sum(pca.allocated_days), 0)::numeric as allocated_days
      from public.phl_claim_allocations pca
      where pca.claim_record_id = claim.id
        and pca.reversed_at is null
    ) allocation_data on true
    left join lateral (
      select
        greatest(
          coalesce(pcal.employee_override_before, 0)
          -
          coalesce(pcal.employee_override_after, 0),
          0
        )::numeric as override_consumed_days
      from public.phl_claim_audit_logs pcal
      where pcal.claim_record_id = claim.id
        and pcal.action = 'hr_approved'
      order by pcal.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) approval_data on true
    where lower(coalesce(claim.source, '')) = 'employee_phl_claim'
      and (
        lower(coalesce(claim.status, '')) = 'approved'
        or lower(coalesce(claim.hr_status, '')) = 'approved'
      )
      and claim.employee_id is not null
  ),
  claim_agg as (
    select
      ct.employee_id,
      count(*)::bigint as approved_claim_count,
      count(*) filter (
        where ct.tracking_gap_days > 0.0001
      )::bigint as legacy_untracked_claim_count,
      count(*) filter (
        where ct.tracking_gap_days > 0.0001
          and ct.legacy_review_status = 'reviewed'
      )::bigint as reviewed_legacy_claim_count
    from claim_tracking ct
    group by ct.employee_id
  ),
  pending_agg as (
    select
      claim.employee_id,
      count(*)::bigint as pending_claim_count
    from public.phl_records claim
    where lower(coalesce(claim.source, '')) = 'employee_phl_claim'
      and lower(
        coalesce(
          nullif(claim.hr_status, ''),
          claim.status,
          ''
        )
      ) in ('pending', 'submitted', 'waiting_hr')
      and claim.employee_id is not null
    group by claim.employee_id
  ),
  latest_review as (
    select distinct on (pral.employee_id)
      pral.employee_id,
      pral.actor_email,
      pral.created_at,
      pral.note
    from public.phl_reconciliation_audit_logs pral
    where pral.action = 'employee_review'
      and pral.employee_id is not null
    order by pral.employee_id, pral.created_at desc
  )
  select
    e.id as employee_id,
    e.employee_number::text,
    e.full_name::text,
    e.department::text,
    e.position::text,
    e.phl_balance::numeric as manual_phl_balance,
    coalesce(sa.active_ledger_balance, 0)::numeric as active_ledger_balance,
    case
      when e.phl_balance is null then null
      else (
        e.phl_balance::numeric
        -
        coalesce(sa.active_ledger_balance, 0)::numeric
      )
    end as manual_ledger_difference,
    coalesce(sa.expired_remaining_balance, 0)::numeric as expired_remaining_balance,
    coalesce(sa.total_earned_days, 0)::numeric as total_earned_days,
    coalesce(sa.total_used_days, 0)::numeric as total_used_days,
    coalesce(pa.pending_claim_count, 0)::bigint as pending_claim_count,
    coalesce(ca.approved_claim_count, 0)::bigint as approved_claim_count,
    coalesce(ca.legacy_untracked_claim_count, 0)::bigint as legacy_untracked_claim_count,
    coalesce(ca.reviewed_legacy_claim_count, 0)::bigint as reviewed_legacy_claim_count,
    case
      when coalesce(ca.legacy_untracked_claim_count, 0) > 0
        then 'needs_review'
      when e.phl_balance is not null
        and abs(
          e.phl_balance::numeric
          -
          coalesce(sa.active_ledger_balance, 0)::numeric
        ) > 0.0001
        then 'manual_difference'
      else 'healthy'
    end::text as reconciliation_status,
    lr.actor_email::text as last_reviewed_by,
    lr.created_at as last_reviewed_at,
    lr.note::text as last_review_note
  from public.employees e
  left join source_agg sa
    on sa.employee_id = e.id
  left join claim_agg ca
    on ca.employee_id = e.id
  left join pending_agg pa
    on pa.employee_id = e.id
  left join latest_review lr
    on lr.employee_id = e.id
  where coalesce(e.is_active, true) = true
     or sa.employee_id is not null
     or ca.employee_id is not null
     or pa.employee_id is not null
  order by
    case
      when coalesce(ca.legacy_untracked_claim_count, 0) > 0 then 1
      when e.phl_balance is not null
        and abs(
          e.phl_balance::numeric
          -
          coalesce(sa.active_ledger_balance, 0)::numeric
        ) > 0.0001 then 2
      else 3
    end,
    e.full_name;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_record_phl_employee_review(p_employee_id uuid, p_note text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_employee public.employees%rowtype;
  v_actor_role text;
  v_actor_email text;
  v_note text;

  v_active_ledger numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_expired_remaining numeric(10, 2) := 0;
  v_difference numeric(10, 2) := null;
  v_legacy_gap_count integer := 0;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise exception 'Sesi login tidak ditemukan. Silakan login ulang.';
  end if;

  select
    lower(coalesce(au.role, '')),
    lower(coalesce(au.email, ''))
  into
    v_actor_role,
    v_actor_email
  from public.app_users au
  where au.id = auth.uid()
    and coalesce(au.is_active, true) = true
  limit 1;

  if not (
    coalesce(v_actor_role, '') like '%hr%'
    or coalesce(v_actor_role, '') like '%admin%'
  ) then
    raise exception 'Hanya akun HR/Admin aktif yang dapat mencatat review rekonsiliasi.';
  end if;

  v_note := btrim(coalesce(p_note, ''));

  if length(v_note) < 5 then
    raise exception 'Catatan review minimal 5 karakter.';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_employee
  from public.employees
  where id = p_employee_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Data employee tidak ditemukan.';
  end if;

  select
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case
          when lower(coalesce(pr.status, '')) = 'approved'
            and coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
            and (
              pr.expired_at is null
              or pr.expired_at >= current_date
            )
          then coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0)
          else 0
        end
      ),
      0
    )::numeric,
    coalesce(
      sum(
        case
          when lower(coalesce(pr.status, '')) = 'approved'
            and coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
            and pr.expired_at is not null
            and pr.expired_at < current_date
          then coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0)
          else 0
        end
      ),
      0
    )::numeric
  into
    v_active_ledger,
    v_expired_remaining
  from public.phl_records pr
  where pr.employee_id = v_employee.id
    and lower(coalesce(pr.source, '')) = 'attendance_phl_approved';

  if v_employee.phl_balance is not null then
    v_difference := v_employee.phl_balance::numeric - v_active_ledger;
  end if;

  with tracking as (
    select
      claim.id,
      abs(
        coalesce(
          nullif(claim.used_days, 0),
          nullif(claim.balance_days, 0),
          0
        )::numeric
        -
        (
          coalesce(allocation_data.allocated_days, 0)::numeric
          +
          coalesce(approval_data.override_consumed_days, 0)::numeric
        )
      )::numeric as tracking_gap_days
    from public.phl_records claim
    left join lateral (
      select
        coalesce(sum(pca.allocated_days), 0)::numeric as allocated_days
      from public.phl_claim_allocations pca
      where pca.claim_record_id = claim.id
        and pca.reversed_at is null
    ) allocation_data on true
    left join lateral (
      select
        greatest(
          coalesce(pcal.employee_override_before, 0)
          -
          coalesce(pcal.employee_override_after, 0),
          0
        )::numeric as override_consumed_days
      from public.phl_claim_audit_logs pcal
      where pcal.claim_record_id = claim.id
        and pcal.action = 'hr_approved'
      order by pcal.created_at desc
      limit 1
    ) approval_data on true
    where claim.employee_id = v_employee.id
      and lower(coalesce(claim.source, '')) = 'employee_phl_claim'
      and (
        lower(coalesce(claim.status, '')) = 'approved'
        or lower(coalesce(claim.hr_status, '')) = 'approved'
      )
  )
  select count(*)::integer
  into v_legacy_gap_count
  from tracking
  where tracking_gap_days > 0.0001;

  insert into public.phl_reconciliation_audit_logs (
    employee_id,
    claim_record_id,
    employee_number,
    full_name,
    action,
    active_ledger_balance,
    expired_remaining_balance,
    manual_phl_balance,
    manual_ledger_difference,
    tracking_gap_days,
    legacy_gap_count,
    actor_user_id,
    actor_email,
    note,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    v_employee.id,
    null,
    v_employee.employee_number,
    v_employee.full_name,
    'employee_review',
    v_active_ledger,
    v_expired_remaining,
    v_employee.phl_balance,
    v_difference,
    null,
    v_legacy_gap_count,
    auth.uid(),
    coalesce(nullif(v_actor_email, ''), 'HR Administrator'),
    v_note,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'balance_changed', false,
      'review_only', true
    )
  );

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'employee_id', v_employee.id,
    'active_ledger_balance', v_active_ledger,
    'expired_remaining_balance', v_expired_remaining,
    'manual_phl_balance', v_employee.phl_balance,
    'manual_ledger_difference', v_difference,
    'legacy_gap_count', v_legacy_gap_count,
    'message', 'Review rekonsiliasi PHL berhasil dicatat tanpa mengubah saldo.'
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.hr_upsert_harmony_request_type(p_code text, p_label text, p_group_label text DEFAULT 'Keterangan Lain'::text, p_request_category text DEFAULT 'other'::text, p_attendance_status text DEFAULT 'absent'::text, p_description text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_requires_proof boolean DEFAULT false, p_requires_manual_time boolean DEFAULT false, p_is_leave_like boolean DEFAULT false, p_is_absence_like boolean DEFAULT true, p_show_in_attendance boolean DEFAULT true, p_show_in_leave boolean DEFAULT true, p_sort_order integer DEFAULT 500)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_code text := lower(btrim(coalesce(p_code, '')));
  v_label text := btrim(coalesce(p_label, ''));
  v_actor text;
  v_existing public.harmony_request_types%rowtype;
begin
  if not public.harmony_leave_is_active_hr_admin() then
    raise exception 'Hanya HR/Admin aktif yang dapat mengelola jenis kehadiran/ketidakhadiran.';
  end if;

  if v_code !~ '^[a-z0-9_]{3,60}$' then
    raise exception 'Kode hanya boleh huruf kecil, angka, underscore, minimal 3 karakter.';
  end if;

  if length(v_label) < 3 then
    raise exception 'Nama jenis minimal 3 karakter.';
  end if;

  v_actor := coalesce(nullif(lower(auth.jwt() ->> 'email'), ''), 'HR Administrator');

  select * into v_existing
  from public.harmony_request_types
  where code = v_code;

  if found and coalesce(v_existing.is_system, false) then
    raise exception 'Jenis sistem % tidak boleh diubah melalui master custom.', v_existing.label;
  end if;

  insert into public.harmony_request_types (
    code, label, group_label, request_category, attendance_status,
    correction_type, description, requires_proof, requires_manual_time,
    is_leave_like, is_absence_like, is_phl_claim,
    show_in_attendance, show_in_leave, is_system, is_active, sort_order,
    created_by, updated_by, updated_at
  ) values (
    v_code,
    v_label,
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_group_label, '')), ''), 'Keterangan Lain'),
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_request_category, '')), ''), 'other'),
    coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_attendance_status, '')), ''), 'absent'),
    v_code,
    nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_description, '')), ''),
    coalesce(p_requires_proof, false),
    coalesce(p_requires_manual_time, false),
    coalesce(p_is_leave_like, false),
    coalesce(p_is_absence_like, true),
    false,
    coalesce(p_show_in_attendance, true),
    coalesce(p_show_in_leave, true),
    false,
    true,
    greatest(coalesce(p_sort_order, 500), 1),
    v_actor,
    v_actor,
    now()
  )
  on conflict (code) do update
  set
    label = excluded.label,
    group_label = excluded.group_label,
    request_category = excluded.request_category,
    attendance_status = excluded.attendance_status,
    correction_type = excluded.correction_type,
    description = excluded.description,
    requires_proof = excluded.requires_proof,
    requires_manual_time = excluded.requires_manual_time,
    is_leave_like = excluded.is_leave_like,
    is_absence_like = excluded.is_absence_like,
    show_in_attendance = excluded.show_in_attendance,
    show_in_leave = excluded.show_in_leave,
    is_active = true,
    sort_order = excluded.sort_order,
    updated_by = v_actor,
    updated_at = now();

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'code', v_code,
    'message', 'Jenis kehadiran/ketidakhadiran berhasil disimpan.'
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phl_get_effective_balance(p_employee_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select (
    coalesce(
      (
        select sum(coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0))
        from public.phl_records pr
        where pr.employee_id = p_employee_id
          and lower(coalesce(pr.source, '')) = 'attendance_phl_approved'
          and lower(coalesce(pr.status, '')) = 'approved'
          and coalesce(pr.remaining_days, 0) > 0
          and (
            pr.expired_at is null
            or pr.expired_at >= public.harmony_today_wita()
          )
      ),
      0
    )
    +
    coalesce(
      (
        select lb.remaining_days
        from public.phl_employee_legacy_balances lb
        where lb.employee_id = p_employee_id
      ),
      0
    )
  )::numeric;
$function$

 RETURNS numeric

 SET search_path TO 'public'

  v_balance numeric(10,2) := 0;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_phl_claim(p_claim_record_id uuid, p_rejected_by text, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  v_claim record;
begin
  select *
  into v_claim
  from phl_records
  where id = p_claim_record_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    return 'Klaim PHL tidak ditemukan.';
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_claim.source, '') <> 'employee_phl_claim' then
    return 'Record ini bukan pengajuan Klaim PHL.';
  end if;

  if coalesce(v_claim.status, '') = 'approved' then
    return 'Klaim PHL sudah disetujui HR, tidak bisa ditolak.';
  end if;

  update phl_records
  set
    status = 'rejected',
    hr_status = 'rejected',
    hr_approved_by = p_rejected_by,
    hr_approved_at = now(),
    approved_by = p_rejected_by,
    approved_at = now(),
    notes = coalesce(notes, '') ||
      E'\nKlaim PHL ditolak HR.' ||
      case
        when p_reason is not null and trim(p_reason) <> ''
        then E' Alasan: ' || p_reason
        else ''
      end,
    updated_at = now()
  where id = p_claim_record_id;

  return 'Klaim PHL berhasil ditolak HR.';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remed_next_claim_number()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_period text := to_char(now(), 'YYYYMM');
  v_next integer;
begin
  insert into public.remed_claim_sequences(period_key,last_value,updated_at)
  values(v_period,1,now())
  on conflict(period_key) do update
    set last_value = public.remed_claim_sequences.last_value + 1, updated_at=now()
  returning last_value into v_next;
  return 'RM-' || v_period || '-' || lpad(v_next::text,5,'0');
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rollback_employee_phl_usage(p_leave_request_id uuid, p_actor_name text DEFAULT 'System'::text, p_actor_role text DEFAULT 'system'::text, p_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  r record;
  v_before numeric;
  v_after numeric;
  v_total numeric := 0;
begin
  if exists (
    select 1
    from employee_phl_usage_transactions
    where leave_request_id = p_leave_request_id
      and transaction_type = 'rollback'
  ) then
    return 'Transaksi PHL ini sudah pernah di-rollback.';
  end if;

  for r in
    select *
    from employee_phl_usage_transactions
    where leave_request_id = p_leave_request_id
      and transaction_type = 'use'
    order by created_at asc
  loop
    select coalesce(remaining_days, 0)
    into v_before
    from phl_records
    where id = r.phl_record_id;

    v_after := coalesce(v_before, 0) + coalesce(r.transaction_days, 0);

    update phl_records
    set
      used_days = greatest(coalesce(used_days, 0) - coalesce(r.transaction_days, 0), 0),
      remaining_days = v_after,
      updated_at = now()
    where id = r.phl_record_id;

    insert into employee_phl_usage_transactions (
      phl_record_id,
      employee_id,
      leave_request_id,
      transaction_type,
      transaction_label,
      transaction_days,
      before_balance,
      after_balance,
      actor_name,
      actor_role,
      notes,
      created_at
    )
    values (
      r.phl_record_id,
      r.employee_id,
      p_leave_request_id,
      'rollback',
      'Rollback Pemakaian Saldo PHL',
      coalesce(r.transaction_days, 0),
      v_before,
      v_after,
      p_actor_name,
      p_actor_role,
      coalesce(p_note, 'Rollback saldo PHL.'),
      now()
    );

    v_total := v_total + coalesce(r.transaction_days, 0);
  end loop;

  if v_total = 0 then
    return 'Tidak ada transaksi PHL yang perlu di-rollback.';
  end if;

  return 'Rollback saldo PHL berhasil. Total dikembalikan: ' || v_total || ' hari.';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_approved_leave_requests_to_attendance(p_period_month text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  v_period_start date;
  v_period_end date;

  r record;
  d date;

  v_sync_start date;
  v_sync_end date;

  v_status text;
  v_label text;

  v_existing_id uuid;

  v_total_requests int := 0;
  v_total_days int := 0;
  v_total_inserted int := 0;
  v_total_updated int := 0;
begin
  v_period_start := get_period_start_from_month(p_period_month);
  v_period_end := get_period_end_from_month(p_period_month);

  for r in
    select
      lr.*
    from leave_requests lr
    where lr.start_date is not null
      and lr.end_date is not null
      and lr.end_date::date >= v_period_start
      and lr.start_date::date <= v_period_end
      and coalesce(lr.supervisor_status, 'pending') = 'approved'
      and coalesce(lr.status, 'pending') = 'approved'
  loop
    v_total_requests := v_total_requests + 1;

    v_sync_start := greatest(r.start_date::date, v_period_start);
    v_sync_end := least(r.end_date::date, v_period_end);

    v_status := map_leave_request_to_attendance_status(r.request_type);
    v_label := map_leave_request_to_label(r.request_type, r.leave_type);

    d := v_sync_start;

    while d <= v_sync_end loop
      if is_harmony_working_day(d) then
        v_total_days := v_total_days + 1;

        select al.id
        into v_existing_id
        from attendance_logs al
        where al.employee_id = r.employee_id
          and al.attendance_date::date = d
          and al.deleted_at is null
        order by al.created_at desc nulls last
        limit 1;

        if v_existing_id is not null then
          update attendance_logs
          set
            leave_request_id = r.id,

            employee_id = coalesce(attendance_logs.employee_id, r.employee_id),
            employee_number = coalesce(attendance_logs.employee_number, r.employee_number),
            machine_pin = coalesce(attendance_logs.machine_pin, r.machine_pin),
            full_name = coalesce(attendance_logs.full_name, r.full_name),
            department = coalesce(attendance_logs.department, r.department),
            position = coalesce(attendance_logs.position, r.position),

            status = case
              when attendance_logs.check_in is null
                and attendance_logs.check_out is null
                and attendance_logs.manual_check_in is null
                and attendance_logs.manual_check_out is null
                and attendance_logs.requested_check_in is null
                and attendance_logs.requested_check_out is null
              then v_status
              else attendance_logs.status
            end,

            absence_request_type = r.request_type,
            absence_request_label = v_label,
            absence_request_status = 'approved_supervisor',
            absence_request_source = 'leave_request_approved_sync',

            job_pending = r.job_pending,
            handover_to = r.handover_to,
            handover_note = r.handover_note,

            absence_proof_url = coalesce(attendance_logs.absence_proof_url, r.proof_file_url),
            absence_proof_name = coalesce(attendance_logs.absence_proof_name, r.proof_file_name),

            employee_confirmation_status = coalesce(attendance_logs.employee_confirmation_status, 'submitted'),
            employee_confirmed_at = coalesce(attendance_logs.employee_confirmed_at, r.created_at, now()),

            supervisor_approval_status = 'approved',
            supervisor_approved_by = coalesce(r.supervisor_name, attendance_logs.supervisor_approved_by),
            supervisor_approved_at = coalesce(r.supervisor_approved_at, attendance_logs.supervisor_approved_at, now()),

            hr_approval_status = coalesce(attendance_logs.hr_approval_status, 'pending'),
            hr_final_status = case
              when coalesce(attendance_logs.hr_final_status, '') = 'finalized' then attendance_logs.hr_final_status
              else 'ready_for_hr'
            end,

            correction_status = 'approved',
            correction_type = r.request_type,
            correction_reason = coalesce(
              nullif(r.reason, ''),
              v_label || ' yang sudah disetujui atasan.'
            ),

            notes = coalesce(
              attendance_logs.notes,
              'Data disinkronkan dari pengajuan ' || v_label || ' yang sudah disetujui atasan.'
            ),

            updated_at = now()
          where id = v_existing_id;

          v_total_updated := v_total_updated + 1;
        else
          insert into attendance_logs (
            employee_id,
            employee_number,
            machine_pin,
            full_name,
            department,
            position,

            attendance_date,
            check_in,
            check_out,
            total_punches,
            status,
            source,
            notes,

            leave_request_id,

            absence_request_type,
            absence_request_label,
            absence_request_status,
            absence_request_source,

            job_pending,
            handover_to,
            handover_note,

            absence_proof_url,
            absence_proof_name,

            employee_confirmation_status,
            employee_confirmed_at,

            supervisor_approval_status,
            supervisor_approved_by,
            supervisor_approved_at,

            hr_approval_status,
            hr_final_status,

            correction_status,
            correction_type,
            correction_reason,

            is_phl_candidate,

            created_at,
            updated_at
          )
          values (
            r.employee_id,
            r.employee_number,
            r.machine_pin,
            r.full_name,
            r.department,
            r.position,

            d,
            null,
            null,
            0,
            v_status,
            'leave_request_approved_sync',
            'Data disinkronkan dari pengajuan ' || v_label || ' yang sudah disetujui atasan.',

            r.id,

            r.request_type,
            v_label,
            'approved_supervisor',
            'leave_request_approved_sync',

            r.job_pending,
            r.handover_to,
            r.handover_note,

            r.proof_file_url,
            r.proof_file_name,

            'submitted',
            coalesce(r.created_at, now()),

            'approved',
            r.supervisor_name,
            coalesce(r.supervisor_approved_at, now()),

            'pending',
            'ready_for_hr',

            'approved',
            r.request_type,
            coalesce(
              nullif(r.reason, ''),
              v_label || ' yang sudah disetujui atasan.'
            ),

            false,

            now(),
            now()
          );

          v_total_inserted := v_total_inserted + 1;
        end if;
      end if;

      d := d + interval '1 day';
    end loop;
  end loop;

  return
    'Sync selesai. Request approved dicek: ' || v_total_requests ||
    ', hari kerja tersinkron: ' || v_total_days ||
    ', insert: ' || v_total_inserted ||
    ', update: ' || v_total_updated || '.';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_approved_phl_claims_to_attendance(p_employee_id uuid, p_period_start date, p_period_end date)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  r record;
begin
  for r in
    select
      pr.*,
      e.employee_number as emp_employee_number,
      e.machine_pin as emp_machine_pin,
      e.full_name as emp_full_name,
      e.department as emp_department,
      e.position as emp_position
    from phl_records pr
    left join employees e
      on e.id = pr.employee_id
    where pr.employee_id = p_employee_id
      and pr.source = 'employee_phl_claim'
      and coalesce(pr.supervisor_status, 'pending') = 'approved'
      and coalesce(pr.hr_status, 'waiting_hr') in ('approved', 'waiting_hr')
      and pr.phl_date::date between p_period_start and p_period_end
  loop

    update attendance_logs
    set
      status = 'phl_claim',
      notes = coalesce(r.reason, 'Klaim PHL'),
      phl_claim_record_id = r.id,
      absence_request_type = 'phl_claim',
      absence_request_label = 'Klaim PHL',
      absence_request_status = 'approved_by_supervisor',
      absence_request_source = 'phl_records',
      employee_confirmation_status = coalesce(employee_confirmation_status, 'auto_from_phl_claim'),
      supervisor_approval_status = coalesce(supervisor_approval_status, 'approved'),
      hr_final_status = coalesce(hr_final_status, 'waiting_hr'),
      updated_at = now()
    where employee_id = r.employee_id
      and attendance_date::date = r.phl_date::date
      and deleted_at is null
      and check_in is null
      and check_out is null
      and manual_check_in is null
      and manual_check_out is null;

    if not found then
      insert into attendance_logs (
        employee_id,
        employee_number,
        machine_pin,
        full_name,
        department,
        position,

        attendance_date,
        check_in,
        check_out,
        total_punches,

        status,
        source,
        notes,

        work_duration_minutes,

        phl_claim_record_id,
        absence_request_type,
        absence_request_label,
        absence_request_status,
        absence_request_source,

        employee_confirmation_status,
        supervisor_approval_status,
        hr_final_status,

        created_at,
        updated_at
      )
      select
        r.employee_id,
        coalesce(r.employee_number, r.emp_employee_number, '-'),
        coalesce(r.machine_pin, r.emp_machine_pin, '-'),
        coalesce(r.full_name, r.emp_full_name, '-'),
        coalesce(r.department, r.emp_department, '-'),
        coalesce(r.position, r.emp_position, '-'),

        r.phl_date::date,
        null,
        null,
        0,

        'phl_claim',
        'approved_phl_claim',
        coalesce(r.reason, 'Klaim PHL'),

        0,

        r.id,
        'phl_claim',
        'Klaim PHL',
        'approved_by_supervisor',
        'phl_records',

        'auto_from_phl_claim',
        'approved',
        'waiting_hr',

        now(),
        now()
      where not exists (
        select 1
        from attendance_logs al
        where al.employee_id = r.employee_id
          and al.attendance_date::date = r.phl_date::date
          and al.deleted_at is null
      );
    end if;
  end loop;

  return 'Klaim PHL approved berhasil disinkronkan ke attendance_logs.';
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_phl_balance_from_attendance(p_employee_id uuid, p_period_start date, p_period_end date)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  insert into phl_records (
    source_attendance_log_id,

    employee_id,
    employee_number,
    machine_pin,
    full_name,
    department,
    position,

    phl_date,
    valid_from,
    expired_at,

    reason,
    source,
    status,

    balance_days,
    used_days,
    remaining_days,

    proof_file_url,
    proof_file_name,

    approved_by,
    approved_at,

    notes,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  select
    al.id as source_attendance_log_id,

    al.employee_id,
    coalesce(al.employee_number, e.employee_number, '-') as employee_number,
    coalesce(al.machine_pin, e.machine_pin, '-') as machine_pin,
    coalesce(al.full_name, e.full_name, '-') as full_name,
    coalesce(al.department, e.department, '-') as department,
    coalesce(al.position, e.position, '-') as position,

    al.attendance_date::date as phl_date,
    al.attendance_date::date as valid_from,
    (al.attendance_date::date + interval '90 days')::date as expired_at,

    coalesce(
      nullif(al.employee_daily_note, ''),
      nullif(al.correction_reason, ''),
      'PHL dari absensi hari libur/weekend yang disetujui atasan.'
    ) as reason,

    'attendance_phl_approved' as source,
    'approved' as status,

    1 as balance_days,
    0 as used_days,
    1 as remaining_days,

    al.phl_proof_url as proof_file_url,
    al.phl_proof_name as proof_file_name,

    al.supervisor_approved_by as approved_by,
    coalesce(al.supervisor_approved_at, now()) as approved_at,

    'Saldo PHL otomatis dibuat dari approval absensi atasan.' as notes,
    now() as created_at,
    now() as updated_at

  from attendance_logs al
  left join employees e
    on e.id = al.employee_id
  where al.employee_id = p_employee_id
    and al.deleted_at is null
    and al.attendance_date::date between p_period_start and p_period_end
    and coalesce(al.is_phl_candidate, false) = true
    and al.supervisor_approval_status = 'approved'

  on conflict (source_attendance_log_id)
  do update set
    employee_id = excluded.employee_id,
    employee_number = excluded.employee_number,
    machine_pin = excluded.machine_pin,
    full_name = excluded.full_name,
    department = excluded.department,
    position = excluded.position,

    phl_date = excluded.phl_date,
    valid_from = excluded.valid_from,
    expired_at = excluded.expired_at,

    reason = excluded.reason,
    source = excluded.source,
    status = excluded.status,

    balance_days = excluded.balance_days,
    used_days = coalesce(phl_records.used_days, 0),
    remaining_days = greatest(excluded.balance_days - coalesce(phl_records.used_days, 0), 0),

    proof_file_url = excluded.proof_file_url,
    proof_file_name = excluded.proof_file_name,

    approved_by = excluded.approved_by,
    approved_at = excluded.approved_at,

    notes = excluded.notes,
    updated_at = now();
end;
$function$
